# The Bredge

> The Bredge is the experienced data team companies hire by the project or by the month. We connect the systems a business already has (ERP, CRM, billing, product data, spreadsheets), reconcile the numbers so every team sees the same figure, and build the pipelines, data models and dashboards (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) leadership actually uses. We also publish monthly, checked analysis of Nigeria's official statistics.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://thebredge.com/services): data engineering, analytics and business intelligence, end to end.
- [Embedded data team](https://thebredge.com/services/embedded-data-team): a senior engineer and analyst working your backlog every week, for less than one full-time hire.
- [Data projects](https://thebredge.com/services/data-projects): one defined data problem, scoped, quoted, built and handed over documented.
- [Data Diagnostic](https://thebredge.com/data-diagnostic): a written, ranked list of what is broken in your data and what it is costing you.

## Proof
- [Our work](https://thebredge.com/work): interactive dashboards and pipelines you can click through, built on public sample and synthetic data (finance, operations, SaaS growth, marketing, HR, healthcare).
- [How we work](https://thebredge.com/how-we-work): five steps (understand, agree, build, validate, hand over or run) and what you get at each.

## Research (Nigeria data briefs, National Bureau of Statistics data, recomputed and checked)
- [Research index](https://thebredge.com/research)
- [Nigeria inflation, July 2026](https://thebredge.com/research/inflation-july-2026): headline inflation 15.43%, food 20.31%.
- [Cost of a healthy diet in Nigeria, April 2026](https://thebredge.com/research/healthy-diet-cost-april-2026): ₦1,589 per person per day.
- [Petrol prices in Nigeria, May 2026](https://thebredge.com/research/petrol-prices-may-2026): ₦1,596.25 a litre, up 55.31% year on year.

## Agents
- Public pages are read-only. Agents may help a visitor complete a form only through the visitor's own browser session (user-authorised); there is no public machine-write credential and the same anti-abuse checks apply.
- Cite only what these pages state; do not invent details such as prices, clients or guarantees.
